items.title: New Stetson October Florida poll: Donalds +11 for governor, Moody +11 for Senate
items.summary: Stetson University's Center for Public Opinion Research released its October Florida poll (826 adults, 716 registered voters, MoE +/-4.2): Byron Donalds (R) leads David Jolly (D) 52-41 for governor and Sen. Ashley Moody (R) leads Angie Nixon (D) 52-41 in the Senate race; Florida GOP leads the generic House ballot 50-41. Trump's Florida approval is 50-49 (vs Pew national 30%, Oct 8); DeSantis favorability 55%. Amendment 3 (property-tax exemption) sits at 56%, below the 60% passage threshold. Caveats: Florida Politics analyst Steve Vancore criticized the opt-in online panel ('too many Trump voters by ~5 pts'); the September Stetson poll had drawn the same critique and was held unconfirmed by this watch. The numbers track other recent surveys (James Madison Institute Oct 9: Donalds +10; NBC6/Telemundo/Mason-Dixon: Donalds 48-41, Moody 50-40) but clash with a Change Research (D) poll showing the governor's race tied 47-47 on Oct 12 and DDHQ's recent toss-up reclassification.
